sentiment: Everything almost overflows tonight, yet each part fits — barely, beautifully, enough.

stories.title: Quake Shareware, a CD-ROM just a little too full
stories.summary: A disc packed just past comfortable capacity, shipped anyway — the craft of making something fit when it barely does, and the charm of things that arrive one squeeze beyond full.

stories.title: Linux 7.3 improves performance when running out of vRAM
stories.summary: A system taught to keep working gracefully at the edge of empty — performance found not in more room, but in making the little that remains behave.

stories.title: A Preview of DuckDB v2.0
stories.summary: A database tool that keeps growing more useful without growing more demanding — proof that generosity can be a storage and compute decision.
